# Vendored iiRDS ontologies — DO NOT EDIT

© tekom Deutschland e.V. / iiRDS Consortium.
Licensed under CC BY-ND 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nd/4.0/

These files are redistributed **verbatim**. They are bundled so that
`iirds-validate` runs with zero network access, which is the point of the tool.

Editing them would (a) break CC BY-ND and (b) silently change validation
results. If a term looks wrong, report it upstream:
https://github.com/iirds-consortium/models/issues

Integrity: run `python -m iirds_validate.ontology --verify` to check the files
against `sha256sums.txt`.
